verified_references.user_label: Li et al.2025 Task overlap and representational similarity
verified_references.title: Causes and Consequences of Representational Similarity in Machine Learning Models
verified_references.supported_nearby_claim: The paper manipulates dataset and task overlap and reports greater representation similarity with greater overlap. Its constant-data task experiment varies labels of identical ColorShapeDigit800K images; section5.2 reports increasing CKA with task overlap.
verified_references.does_not_support: It does not test exact algebraic correspondences between distinct specialists under transformed-input pairing, nor establish a universal mathematics-specific mechanism.

alternative_version.title: Exploring Causes of Representational Similarity in Machine Learning Models

verified_references.publication_status_limit: OpenReview pV7hqI1fN4 forum/pdf and publicAPI returned browser challenge/HTTP403. Primary arXiv identity and findings verified; ICLR2026 acceptance is not verified, so cite2025preprint rather than accepted conference.
verified_references.evidence_location: arXivv2 abstract; sections3.2,4.1,5.2; v1/v2 abstract pages confirm title change

verified_references.title: Representation Similarity Analysis for Efficient Task Taxonomy & Transfer Learning
verified_references.venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
verified_references.supported_nearby_claim: Uses RSA between task-trained visual models to construct a task taxonomy; evaluates its relation to transfer performance on Taskonomy and PascalVOC semantic segmentation.
verified_references.does_not_support: This is task taxonomy/transfer evidence, not exact known mathematical-relation selectivity or proof that CKA alignment interventions improve function.

verified_references.title: ReSi: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Representational Similarity Measures
verified_references.supported_nearby_claim: Benchmarks24representation similarity measures across14architectures and7datasets using6tests. It distinguishes prediction-grounded tests (accuracy/output differences) from design-grounded tests (label randomization, shortcut affinity, augmentation, layer monotonicity).
verified_references.does_not_support: Its groundings are declared predictive/design assumptions, not a universally known latent geometric ground truth. It does not by itself validate the present exact-relation assay.
verified_references.version_note: Use ICLR2025published scope24/14/7; the original2024arXivabstract had earlier counts23/11/6.
verified_references.evidence_location: Official proceedings abstract/BibTeX; final paper section3.1/Table1

verified_references.title: Deconfounded Representation Similarity for Comparison of Neural Networks
verified_references.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems35 (NeurIPS2022)
verified_references.supported_nearby_claim: Shows input-population structure can produce high RSA/CKA for random networks and misleading functional comparisons; proposes covariate-adjustment regression to remove the chosen confounder while preserving original invariances.
verified_references.does_not_support: The adjustment removes the specified input-structure covariate under that method; it does not remove every output/confidence/nonlinear answer explanation or identify mathematical mechanisms.
verified_references.evidence_location: Official NeurIPS2022abstract and BibTeX; original paper abstract

verified_references.title: Revisiting the Platonic Representation Hypothesis: An Aristotelian View
verified_references.venue: Proceedings of the43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML2026), PMLR306
verified_references.supported_nearby_claim: Reports width/depth confounding of representation-similarity scores and introduces permutation-null calibration. Its reanalysis distinguishes attenuation of global spectral convergence from retained local neighborhood agreement.
verified_references.does_not_support: Calibration is an alternative measurement/reference framework; it is not equivalent to subtracting a matched trained-initial preference and cannot retroactively make this study confirmatory.
verified_references.author_spelling_note: Official PMLR metadata and BibTeX spell Brbic without diacritic; arXiv lists Maria Brbić. Preserve official entry for conference citation.

verified_references.title: Position: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis
verified_references.venue: Proceedings of the41st International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML2024), PMLR235
verified_references.supported_nearby_claim: A position paper proposes convergence toward a shared statistical model and reports cross-modality similarity trends as vision/language model scale grows; discusses pressures, limitations and counterexamples.
verified_references.does_not_support: It proposes a hypothesis, not a theorem that every relation, encoding, layer, metric or task-set must converge, and does not establish the present causal mechanism.
verified_references.title_note: The official conference title includes Position:, unlike arXiv.

verified_references.title: Convergent World Representations and Divergent Tasks
verified_references.venue: Proceedings of the43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML2026), PMLR306
verified_references.supported_nearby_claim: Uses5075city coordinates and7geometric tasks with autoregressive Transformers. Multi-task models trained on non-overlapping tasksets develop aligned world geometry, while some tasks impair integrating new cities through fine-tuning.
verified_references.does_not_support: It concerns city-task world geometry and entity adaptation, not the present exact permutation/matrix task identities or causal functional benefit of imposing CKA.

verified_references.title: Permutations as a testbed for studying the effect of input representations on learning
verified_references.venue: Methods and Opportunities at Small Scale (MOSS), ICML2025Workshop
verified_references.supported_nearby_claim: Uses permutations and statistics to study how input encoding, dataset size and model family (MLP/Transformer) affect learning. Five input formats are permutation matrices, inversion vectors, Lehmer cocodes, major codes and lexicographically minimal reduced words.
verified_references.does_not_support: It does not use our one-line versus canonical-cycle comparison. Its discussion proposes internal-representation comparisons as future work; do not say it already performed our transformed-input/step0/answer-controlled geometry analysis.
verified_references.evidence_location: Search-indexed original OpenReviewPDFfirstpage:title/full5authors and accepted MOSS ICML2025footer; section3.3 fiveencodings and section5discussion.
